usageNotes: Use this to check the health and quorum state of all nodes in a remote PVE cluster managed by PDM. The response mixes two record types — one cluster-level record (type: 'cluster') carrying quorate and node count, and one node-level record per member (type: 'node') carrying online status, subscription level, and IP. Requires Resource.Audit on the named remote; the optional target-endpoint parameter can redirect the connection through a specific PDM endpoint when the remote has multiple configured.

examples.summary: Check cluster quorum and node online status for a remote named 'hetzner-pve'

tips: Filter the response by type === 'cluster' to get the single quorum record; filter by type === 'node' for per-node detail.
The 'local' field on node records marks the node that actually handled the query — useful for confirming which node PDM reached.
A quorate: false result means the cluster has lost majority; VMs may still be running but HA and config changes are blocked.
The 'level' field reflects the Proxmox subscription tier (e.g. 'c' = Community, 'b' = Basic, 's' = Standard, 'p' = Premium) and determines access to the enterprise repository.
